title: Venezuelan-Style Roasted Noodle Bake
description: A fusion dish that combines Venezuelan flavors with roasted noodles, perfect for a comforting meal.

ingredients.name: noodles
ingredients.notes: any type of noodle, but wide noodles work best

instructions: Cook the noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic, chili flakes, cumin, and paprika to the skillet. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the cooked noodles, egg, and the skillet mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
